mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical thirteen-period Elder Force Index crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a change in the sign of volume-weighted close-to-close impulse; follow the new impulse direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when smoothed Force Index crosses strictly above zero from at or below zero; short when it crosses strictly below zero from at or above zero
mechanism.why_distinct: HVFI multiplies completed close change by exact base volume and exponentially smooths the signed impulse. It is volume-weighted price force rather than a price-only band/channel/oscillator, taker-flow split, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 state primitive.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, where the volume-backed impulse sign filters small direction changes
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour base-volume Force Index sign-change clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including summed base volume and quote_asset_volume
features.raw_force: (current completed close-prior completed close)*current four-hour base volume on consecutive valid bars
features.force_index: 13-period EMA of raw force, alpha=2/14, adjust=false, minimum 13 consecutive valid transitions
features.cross: current Force Index strictly crosses zero from immediately prior valid Force Index
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Elder Force Index zero cross under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no volume field, force formula, EMA period, zero line, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: one-period force=(current close-prior close)*current base volume; 13-period exponential moving average with adjust=false; zero-line direction
external_basis.selection_use: published formula, smoothing period, and zero-line direction only; no incidence or outcomes
